services.desc: Early Steps programming at the Hiland is designed to provide a safe space for children to be introduced to dance, music and movement through play, while improving locomotor, developmental and social skills. Play, as an integral part of creativity, inspires children at this age to share, compare, and dare! Each themed weeklong camp includes a movement class, a snack, and a craft! Tuition: $150 per weekOne-Time Registration Fee: $25Multi Camp Discounts: 10% off 4 day week due to Juneteenth Holiday & Independence Day Holiday (observed). 4 day week Tuition: $120.
